title: A compliance podcast works through the FT's business list
summary: Tom Fox devotes a Sunday Book Review to the four business titles on the Financial Times selection, alongside Jill Lepore, Alex Edmans and Nigel Cope. His audience is compliance officers rather than founders.
attribution_title: Compliance Podcast Network, Sunday Book Review
blockquote: Over the next several episodes, Tom will look at some of the best books of the year, as identified by the Financial Times. Today, he looks at 4 top business books.
